hook: Eight charges just landed against Poland's central bank governor in an unprecedented parliamentary indictment.

sections.voiceover: Eight charges just landed against Poland's central bank governor in an unprecedented parliamentary indictment.
b_roll: Exterior shot of the National Bank of Poland building in Warsaw
Close-up of official parliamentary documents on a wooden desk

sections.voiceover: Thirty-three committee meetings preceded the October 9 vote on National Bank of Poland chief Adam Glapiński. Eleven members backed the report while eight opposed it. Where did those eight charges originate?
b_roll: Wide shot of committee members sitting at desks in the parliament
Document pages flipping to reveal a vote tally sheet

sections.voiceover: Prime Minister Donald Tusk's ruling coalition wants Adam Glapiński deposed.
b_roll: Press conference microphones with Polish flags in the background
Portrait shot of Prime Minister Donald Tusk speaking

sections.voiceover: National Bank of Poland governor Adam Glapiński faces eight charges. Two members abstained during the final committee tally.
b_roll: Stacks of government financial reports and monetary policy charts
Gavel striking a wooden block inside the courtroom

sections.voiceover: Poland's central bank faces its biggest political trial yet.
b_roll: National Bank of Poland logo etched on a glass door
Slow pan across the Warsaw skyline at dusk
